finding.title: Persist prior process cleanup failure when initial device cleanup throws before receipt write
finding.observed: prepare records process_cleanup_failed in memory; initial cleanup check_device query throws before cleanup.persist; main finally catch prints and returns primary124 without persisting. Later cleanup action loads processCleanupFailed=false and writes cleanupPASS/exit0 despite prior real process cleanup FAIL.
finding.impact: CI uploaded final receipt erases earlier unverified process cleanup from prepare; successful simulator delete cannot attest earlier process-group quiescence.
finding.requiredFix: Persist monotonic process cleanup failure and truthful prior cleanup failure only when current process acquired/validated its own record, even if initial cleanup throws; preserve primary124/7/143/130. Subsequent cleanup may delete own device but aggregate process failure must remain FAIL. Keep private ownership and stale/foreign guards, no mutation from invalid receipt.
finding.regression: real prepare entrypoint with synthetic bootstatus timeout+process cleanup failure followed by failing initial cleanup identity query, then new cleanup process/reopen+successful delete: initial and final processCleanupFailed true, finalcleanup FAIL, exits124 then1

independentPoC.scope: actual main/prepare/cleanup/private file/reopen, synthetic tool replies, no native process/simulator/build

ciEvidence.qualification: Root cause of actual process-group cleanup probe FAIL remains unknown from generic catch; finding is independently reproduced persistence loss, not a claim about actual descendant liveness.

repositoryMutationScope: own ignored receipt and independent PoC only
